findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司自述市場技術變動快，競爭對手推出新技術可能使現有產品過時；且競爭者採用類似長晶技術的基板愈來愈多，已侵蝕公司的技術差異化。
findings.excerpt: If our competitors introduce products employing new technologies or performance characteristics, our existing products could become obsolete and unmarketable. Over time, we have seen our competitors selling more substrates manufactured using a crystal growth technology similar to ours, which has eroded our technological differentiation.

findings.claim: Fraunhofer ISE 與 III/V-Reclaim 開發 InP-on-GaAs 基板（至 150mm），定位為可取代 prime InP 晶圓的較低成本替代方案
findings.source: Fraunhofer ISE 新聞稿 InP on GaAs substrates can replace prime indium phosphide wafers
findings.excerpt: phosphide on gallium arsenide substrates (InP-on-GaAs wafers) with up to 150 mm diameter. These new wafers can effectively replace classic indium phosphide in a variety of applications, offering a scalable pathway to lower cost. The research team developed a process to deposit a thin layer of high-quality InP on GaAs.

note: 搜尋未見有替代材料已取代 InP 基板的來源；Fraunhofer ISE 與 III/V-Reclaim 的 InP-on-GaAs 工程基板（最大 150mm，定位為取代 prime InP 晶圓的低成本路線）僅有搜尋摘要，列為 clue 待核原文。中國同業（Vital Micro、浙江先導）6 吋 InP 量產／擴產另見搜尋結果，未讀頁面。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
